ports: UIController menu repeat: first repeat after 300 ms; subsequent repeats every 100 ms.
Original HUD720/HUD1080 display lists and decompiled fourj.documents.Hud layout, scale, state and safe-zone code.
640x360 menu canvas: factor 2/3/4/6 at 720/1080/1440/2160 height; manual Java GUI scale remains available.
adaptations: The SDL2 canonical game-controller API maps physical button positions to LCE actions; glyph choice does not remap actions.
1080p assets/layout are proportionally scaled for 1440p and 2160p. Later Java features without LCE artwork use native assets.
The existing user-requested footer position/size and blue menu highlight are preserved; HD glyph bitmap exports are selected at 1080p and above.
